name: Allen

council.structure: Mayor + 6 council members (Places 1-6), all elected citywide (no districts); council-manager form of government
council.termNote: Staggered three-year terms with elections in May. Mayor Schulmeister's term runs 2026-2029. Mayor Pro Tem Carl Clemencich (Place 5, 2024-2027); Michael Schaeffer (Place 1, 2024-2027), Tommy Baril (Place 2, 2026-2029), Ken Cook (Place 3, 2024-2027), Amy Gnadt (Place 4, 2025-2028), Ben Trahan (Place 6, 2025-2028).

meetings.label: City Council Regular Meeting

recurrence.notes: Second and fourth Tuesdays at 7 p.m. Upcoming: Sept. 22, Oct. 13, Oct. 27, Nov. 10, Nov. 24, Dec. 8, Dec. 22. The city's events calendar lists the fourth-Tuesday meetings (Sept. 22, Oct. 27, Nov. 24, Dec. 22) at 7 to 9 p.m. with no cancellations posted as of Sept. 10; the second-Tuesday dates follow the published schedule but were not individually confirmed, and dates near Thanksgiving and Christmas could change.

meetings.location: Council Chambers, Allen City Hall, 305 Century Parkway, Allen, TX 75013
meetings.notes: Citizens' Comments period near the start of each regular meeting for topics not on the agenda and not set for public hearing (3 minutes per speaker, 15 minutes total); public hearings take comment on their items. Agendas post at least three business days before the meeting.

meetings.label: City Council Workshop

recurrence.notes: 6 p.m. before each regular meeting in the basement meeting rooms of City Hall (the Sept. 8, 2026 workshop was in Basement Meeting Rooms A and B).

meetings.location: Basement Meeting Rooms A and B, Allen City Hall, 305 Century Parkway, Allen, TX 75013
meetings.notes: Discussion items, council liaison updates and questions on the evening's agenda; no citizens' comments period is listed on workshop agendas. The council also holds a multi-day budget workshop each August (Aug. 21-23 in 2026).

agendaPortal.notes: Current agendas are published through AgendaLink (JustMeetings), embedded on the city agendas page; the embed itself is https://horizon.agendalink.app/engage-v2/allentx/agendas and needs JavaScript. Minutes are in the Laserfiche public records portal (http://publicrecords.cityofallen.org/WebLink/Browse.aspx). The older NovusAgenda site (https://allen.novusagenda.com/agendapublic/) showed no records as of Sept. 10, 2026. Email alerts for agenda postings: https://cityofallen.org/enotify/index.php.

liveStream.notes: ACTV (Allen City Television) streams council and Planning and Zoning meetings live on its YouTube channel (City of Allen - ACTV) and at https://actv.org/internetchannel/watch-now; cable Frontier 15, Grande 15, Spectrum 16. Recordings are usually available the next day through the on-demand player linked from https://www.cityofallen.org/government/watch_public_meetings.php.

publicComment.summary: Sign up online with the Public Speaker Request Form (it opens at 5 p.m. the Friday before the meeting and closes at 5 p.m. on meeting day) or fill out a paper Public Meeting Appearance Card at City Hall and give it to the City Secretary before the 7 p.m. meeting. You can speak on any topic not on the agenda for up to 3 minutes during Citizens' Comments (15 minutes total for all speakers), but the council cannot vote that night on things that are not on the agenda.
publicComment.howToRegister: 1) Online: open the Public Speaker Request Form between 5 p.m. Friday before the meeting and 5 p.m. on meeting day and enter your name, address and topic. 2) In person: pick up a paper Public Meeting Appearance Card in the Council Chambers at 305 Century Parkway and hand it to the City Secretary before the meeting begins. 3) When called, go to the podium, state your name and address for the record, and speak; groups should choose one spokesperson.
publicComment.deadline: Online form closes at 5 p.m. on meeting day; paper cards accepted until the meeting is called to order at 7 p.m.
publicComment.writtenCommentMethod: No dedicated written-comment form is published; email the City Secretary, Shelley George (sgeorge@allentx.gov, 214-509-4105), to have comments forwarded to the council.
publicComment.notes: The Sept. 8, 2026 agenda states: 'The City Council invites citizens to speak to the Council on any topic not on the agenda or not already scheduled for Public Hearing. Prior to the meeting, please complete a Public Meeting Appearance Card and present it to the City Secretary. The time limit is three minutes per speaker, not to exceed a total of fifteen minutes for all speakers.' Speakers on agenda items and public hearings are heard when that item comes up. Council may refer non-agenda issues to staff or a future agenda but cannot act on them the same night. Sign interpreters or special services: call the City Secretary at 214-509-4105 at least 48 hours ahead.

youthPrograms.name: Allen Teen Court and Teen Court Academy
youthPrograms.ages: 13-17 (some 18-year-olds still in school); must be enrolled in a public, private or home school
youthPrograms.description: Teens volunteer as jurors and attorneys to hear real Class C misdemeanor cases involving their peers; defendants who complete the program have charges dismissed. Attorney volunteers must first finish the Teen Court Academy, which meets on three Mondays, and missing the orientation or a lecture means not graduating as an attorney.
youthPrograms.applyWindow: Next Teen Court Academy begins fall 2026 (attorneys apply through the city's Teen Court Academy application, then register on Eventbrite after finishing); jurors register directly on Eventbrite (https://www.eventbrite.com/o/allen-teen-court-93669457303). Coordinator: 214-509-4393.
